name: 1N4148
description: The default small-signal silicon switching diode. Fast recovery, low capacitance. Used everywhere for signal steering, clipping/clamping, flyback on small relays, and logic. The banded end is the cathode.

DO-35.notes: axial glass body; the painted band marks the cathode.

extra.Ir: 25nA max @ Vr=20V, Tj=25C (50uA max @ Vr=20V, Tj=150C; 5uA max @ Vr=75V)

typical_application: Soft clipping in guitar pedals (two anti-parallel diodes), signal-path steering/OR-ing, flyback protection on small relays and reed switches, charge pumps.
gotchas: band = cathode; reversing it blocks the intended current path
not a rectifier for power; 200mA max, use a 1N400x for mains/power rectification
forward voltage drifts with current and temperature, which matters in clipping and bias circuits
